questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom:
"Pass the baton"

options.B: take part in a relay race

questions.explanation: 'Pass the baton' means to hand over a duty or responsibility to someone else, just as a runner hands the baton to the next runner in a relay.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required':
"He acted in according to my instructions."
questions.explanation: The correct prepositional phrase is 'in accordance with', meaning 'in agreement with'. 'In according to' and 'in according with' are ungrammatical.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank:
The ________ of the new legislation has sparked a heated debate among lawmakers.
questions.explanation: A noun meaning 'result or impact' is needed, which is 'effect'. 'Affect' is usually a verb, 'affectation' means artificial behaviour, and 'effection' is not a standard word.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the question.
Once a severe epidemic broke out in Cuttack. Subhas Bose went there with a small (1) ______ to help the poor and sick people. Some people (2) ______ the work done by Subhas and his friends (3) ______ others made fun of them. Haider was one (4) ______ person who always ridiculed them. Once, when Haider fell ill, Subhas (5) ______ looked after him till he recovered.

Select the most appropriate option for blank no. (1).
questions.explanation: Subhas went with a small group of helpers working together, so 'team' fits best.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the question.
Once a severe epidemic broke out in Cuttack. Subhas Bose went there with a small (1) ______ to help the poor and sick people. Some people (2) ______ the work done by Subhas and his friends (3) ______ others made fun of them. Haider was one (4) ______ person who always ridiculed them. Once, when Haider fell ill, Subhas (5) ______ looked after him till he recovered.

Select the most appropriate option for blank no. (2).
questions.explanation: The sentence contrasts some people with 'others' who made fun of them, so the first group must have 'praised' the work.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the question.
Once a severe epidemic broke out in Cuttack. Subhas Bose went there with a small (1) ______ to help the poor and sick people. Some people (2) ______ the work done by Subhas and his friends (3) ______ others made fun of them. Haider was one (4) ______ person who always ridiculed them. Once, when Haider fell ill, Subhas (5) ______ looked after him till he recovered.

Select the most appropriate option for blank no. (3).
questions.explanation: 'While' joins two contrasting clauses: some praised the work while others made fun of them.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the question.
Once a severe epidemic broke out in Cuttack. Subhas Bose went there with a small (1) ______ to help the poor and sick people. Some people (2) ______ the work done by Subhas and his friends (3) ______ others made fun of them. Haider was one (4) ______ person who always ridiculed them. Once, when Haider fell ill, Subhas (5) ______ looked after him till he recovered.

Select the most appropriate option for blank no. (4).
questions.explanation: 'One such person' is the correct idiomatic structure to refer to a person of the kind just described.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the question.
Once a severe epidemic broke out in Cuttack. Subhas Bose went there with a small (1) ______ to help the poor and sick people. Some people (2) ______ the work done by Subhas and his friends (3) ______ others made fun of them. Haider was one (4) ______ person who always ridiculed them. Once, when Haider fell ill, Subhas (5) ______ looked after him till he recovered.

Select the most appropriate option for blank no. (5).
questions.explanation: The passage stresses Subhas's goodness: he himself took care of the man who ridiculed him, so 'personally looked after him' fits. The other adverbs do not suit the act of nursing someone.

questions.question: उच्चारण स्थान के आधार पर निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा वर्ण ध्वनि का प्रकार नहीं है?
questions.explanation: Devanagari sounds are classified as kanthya, talavya, murdhanya, dantya, oshthya, dantoshthya etc. There is no 'greeva' (neck) category.

questions.question: 'आजकल लेखक उपन्यास लिख रहा है' वाक्य में रेखांकित शब्द 'उपन्यास' में कौन-सा कारक है?
questions.explanation: The action of writing falls on 'उपन्यास', so it is the object of the verb and is in karm karak.

questions.question: हिंदी में पुरुषवाचक सर्वनाम के कितने भेद हैं?
questions.explanation: There are three types: Uttam purush (first person), Madhyam purush (second person) and Anya purush (third person).

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से किस वाक्य में 'कर्मवाच्य' का प्रयोग नहीं हुआ है?
questions.explanation: 'बालक खिलखिलाकर हँस रहा था' is in kartrivachya (active voice) because the subject is the focus of the verb. The other sentences give importance to the object and use the passive form.

questions.question: 'हम चूड़ियाँ पहन रहे हैं।' वाक्य में क्रिया का काल कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: 'Pahan rahe hain' shows an action going on at present and not yet complete, which is apurna (tatkalik) vartaman kaal.

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा वाक्य संयुक्त वाक्य का उदाहरण है?

options.A: जो परिश्रम करेगा, उसे सफलता मिलेगी।
options.B: शाम हुई और गाय घर लौट आई।
options.C: यह वही बच्चा है जो कल गिर गया था।
options.D: वह बीमार होने के कारण विद्यालय नहीं गया।

questions.explanation: A compound sentence joins two independent clauses with a coordinating conjunction such as 'और'. The first two are complex sentences (mishra vakya) and the last is a simple sentence.

questions.question: 'स्त्री जो अभिनय करती हो' वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
questions.explanation: A woman who acts is 'अभिनेत्री' (actress). Nayika is a heroine, nartaki is a dancer and gayika is a singer.

questions.question: 'हाथ को हाथ न सूझना' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?

options.C: किसी की सहायता करने से मना करना

questions.explanation: 'हाथ को हाथ न सूझना' means it is so dark that one cannot even see one's own hand, i.e. very dense darkness.

questions.question:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से वाक्य अशुद्ध हैं?
(1) उसे मृत्यु दंड की सजा हुई।
(2) विंध्याचल पर्वत पर घने जंगल हैं।
(3) यहाँ शुद्ध भैंस का दूध मिलता है।
(4) मेरे को उससे बात करना पसंद नहीं है।
questions.explanation: (1) is redundant: 'दंड' and 'सजा' mean the same, so it should be 'उसे मृत्युदंड मिला'. (3) misplaces the adjective; it should be 'भैंस का शुद्ध दूध'. (4) 'मेरे को' is wrong; it should be 'मुझे'. Sentence (2) is acceptable.

questions.question: 'सिर उठाना' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'सिर उठाना' means to rise in revolt or to oppose.

questions.question: 'थका ऊँट सराय तकता है' लोकोक्ति का सही अर्थ है:

options.A: दिन भर के कठिन परिश्रम के बाद घर याद आता है
options.B: असाध्य रोग से पीड़ित व्यक्ति मृत्यु की कामना करता है
options.D: परिश्रम का फल सदा मीठा होता है

questions.explanation: A tired camel looks towards the inn: after a long day of toil, a person longs for home and rest.

questions.question: संत साहित्य में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा 'बंकनालि' का पर्याय नहीं है?
questions.explanation: As per the source answer key, 'वक्र नालि' is the option that is not treated as a synonym of 'बंकनालि' in sant literature.

questions.question: 'नौका विहार' कविता में गंगा की लहरों के बीच चंद्रमा के प्रतिबिंब के लिए किस नायिका का उल्लेख हुआ है?
questions.explanation: In Sumitranandan Pant's 'Nauka Vihar', the moon's reflection among the waves is compared to a 'मुग्धा' nayika.

questions.question: छायावाद के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन असत्य है?

options.A: छायावादी संवेदना का निर्माण आत्मानुभूति और सौंदर्यमूलक कल्पना से हुआ है।
options.B: छायावादी कवियों ने मुख्य रूप से प्रणय की अनुभूतियों को अभिव्यक्त किया है।
options.C: छायावादी कवि 'निराला' की अनुभूति क्रमशः शैव दर्शन में परिणत होती है।
options.D: छायावादी काव्य में प्रकृति का मानवीकरण हुआ है और उसके प्रति गहरा प्रेम दिखाई देता है।

questions.explanation: As per the source key, statement 1 is false: Chhayavad is not limited mainly to romantic love; it is marked by subjectivity, imagination, mysticism and love for nature.

questions.question: बालकृष्ण शर्मा 'नवीन' का प्रथम प्रकाशित काव्य-संग्रह है:
questions.explanation: 'कुंकुम' (1936) was the first published collection of 'Navin'. Rashmirekha, Apalak and Kvasi came later.

questions.question: 'रीतिकाल' की विशेषताओं के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से एक कथन असत्य है। उसे चुनिए:

options.A: रीतिकाल में अलंकरण की प्रधानता है
options.B: रीतिकाल की प्रमुख भाषा ब्रजभाषा है
options.C: रीतिकालीन काव्य में शृंगार रस की प्रधानता है
options.D: रीतिकाल में प्रकृति का चित्रण आलंबन रूप में हुआ है

questions.explanation: In Ritikal, nature was mostly described in the uddipan (stimulating) form, as a background to love, not as the alamban (main subject).

questions.question: 'रामचरितमानस' के किन कांडों में वीभत्स रस का प्रयोग मिलता है?
questions.explanation: Veebhats ras appears in battle and demon scenes, found in Aranyakand and Lankakand.

questions.question:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।
स्त्रियों की समस्याएँ अनेक और गंभीर हैं। परंतु उनमें से एक भी ऐसी नहीं है जिसका समाधान 'शिक्षा' रूपी जादुई शब्द से न हो सके। पहले अपनी स्त्रियों को शिक्षित कीजिए, फिर उन्हें उनकी स्थिति पर छोड़ दीजिए, वे स्वयं बताएँगी कि उनके लिए कौन-से सुधार आवश्यक हैं। हमें स्त्रियों को ऐसी स्थिति में पहुँचाना चाहिए जहाँ वे अपनी समस्याओं का समाधान अपने ढंग से कर सकें।

गद्यांश में किसकी समस्याओं का उल्लेख है?
questions.explanation: The passage opens with 'The problems of women are many and serious', so it talks about women's problems.

शिक्षा को 'जादुई' क्यों कहा गया होगा?

options.A: शिक्षा समस्याओं का समाधान कर सकती है।
options.B: शिक्षा समस्याओं को सदा के लिए समाप्त कर देती है।
options.D: शिक्षा से तुरंत धन प्राप्त होता है।

questions.explanation: The passage says no problem exists that cannot be solved by education; that problem-solving power is why it is called magical.

गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।
स्त्रियों की समस्याएँ अनेक और गंभीर हैं। परंतु उनमें से एक भी ऐसी नहीं है जिसका समाधान 'शिक्षा' रूपी जादुई शब्द से न हो सके। पहले अपनी स्त्रियों को शिक्षित कीजिए, फिर उन्हें उनकी स्थिति पर छोड़ दीजिए, वे स्वयं बताएँगी कि उनके लिए कौन-से सुधार आवश्यक हैं। हमें स्त्रियों को ऐसी स्थिति में पहुँचाना चाहिए जहाँ वे अपनी समस्याओं का समाधान अपने ढंग से कर सकें।

गद्यांश के अनुसार स्त्रियों में इतनी क्षमता है कि वे:

options.A: बिना किसी सुधार के ही रह सकती हैं।
options.B: पुरुष समाज को पीछे छोड़ सकती हैं।
options.C: स्वयं अपने पूरे समुदाय को शिक्षित कर सकती हैं।
options.D: अपनी समस्याओं का समाधान स्वयं कर सकती हैं।

questions.explanation: The passage says women should be brought to a position where they can solve their problems in their own way.

questions.question:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।
स्त्रियों की समस्याएँ अनेक और गंभीर हैं। परंतु उनमें से एक भी ऐसी नहीं है जिसका समाधान 'शिक्षा' रूपी जादुई शब्द से न हो सके। पहले अपनी स्त्रियों को शिक्षित कीजिए, फिर उन्हें उनकी स्थिति पर छोड़ दीजिए, वे स्वयं बताएँगी कि उनके लिए कौन-से सुधार आवश्यक हैं। हमें स्त्रियों को ऐसी स्थिति में पहुँचाना चाहिए जहाँ वे अपनी समस्याओं का समाधान अपने ढंग से कर सकें।

'स्त्रियाँ अपने सुधार का दायित्व स्वयं ले सकती हैं' यह कथन है:
questions.explanation: The passage says educated women will themselves tell what reforms they need and solve their problems their own way, so the statement is completely accurate.

गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।
स्त्रियों की समस्याएँ अनेक और गंभीर हैं। परंतु उनमें से एक भी ऐसी नहीं है जिसका समाधान 'शिक्षा' रूपी जादुई शब्द से न हो सके। पहले अपनी स्त्रियों को शिक्षित कीजिए, फिर उन्हें उनकी स्थिति पर छोड़ दीजिए, वे स्वयं बताएँगी कि उनके लिए कौन-से सुधार आवश्यक हैं। हमें स्त्रियों को ऐसी स्थिति में पहुँचाना चाहिए जहाँ वे अपनी समस्याओं का समाधान अपने ढंग से कर सकें।

'शिक्षा' शब्द से बना विशेषण है:
questions.explanation: 'शिक्षित' (educated) is the adjective made by adding the suffix '-इत' to 'शिक्षा'. 'शिक्षक' is a noun and 'सीखना' is a verb.

questions.question: Who was the president of the 1927 Madras session of the Congress, where the Indian National Congress adopted the resolution to boycott the 'Simon Commission'?
questions.explanation: Dr. M.A. Ansari presided over the 1927 Madras session, which resolved to boycott the Simon Commission and also passed a resolution for complete independence.

questions.question: On the suggestion of Rabindranath Tagore, the day of the Partition of Bengal (16 October 1905) was observed as:
questions.explanation: On Tagore's call, people tied rakhis to one another on 16 October 1905 as a symbol of unity of Bengal, so the day was observed as Raksha Bandhan Day.

questions.question: Before his arrest during the Quit India Movement, which of the following instructions was NOT laid down by Mahatma Gandhi for the people?

options.A: Keep the nation alive even at the risk of death.
options.B: Paralyse the government administration through a complete strike.
options.C: Consider yourselves subjects of the British Emperor.
options.D: Students may leave their studies if they are confident.

questions.explanation: Gandhi asked people to regard themselves as free, not as subjects of the British Crown. Strikes, 'do or die' and students leaving studies were part of his instructions.

questions.question:
Consider the formation of the following associations before the establishment of the Indian National Congress:
1. The Indian Association (1876)
2. Madras Native Association (1852)
3. Poona Sarvajanik Sabha (1870)
4. Indian League (1875)
Find the correct chronological order of their formation:
questions.explanation: Madras Native Association (1852), Poona Sarvajanik Sabha (1870), Indian League (1875) and Indian Association (1876) gives the order 2, 3, 4, 1.

questions.question: Frontier Gandhi (Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan) formed a party of the Pathans. What was the name of that party?
questions.explanation: Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan founded the Khudai Khidmatgar ('Servants of God'), also known as the Red Shirts. The Khaksar movement was founded by Allama Mashriqi.

questions.concept: Tilak as ocean, Gokhale as Ganga
questions.question: Who compared Tilak to the 'ocean' and Gokhale to the river 'Ganga'?
questions.explanation: Gandhi said Tilak was like the ocean, vast and hard to approach, while Gokhale was like the Ganga, inviting and easy to bathe in.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about peasant movements in India is NOT correct?

options.A: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati formed the Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha in 1929.
options.B: Congress Socialist Party worker N.G. Ranga organised several peasant marches in Andhra in 1933-34 and demanded the abolition of zamindari.
options.C: The Utkal Kisan Sangh was established by the Congress Socialists in 1938.
options.D: The All India Kisan Sabha was formed at Lucknow in 1936.

questions.explanation: The Utkal Kisan Sangh was formed in 1935, not 1938. The other statements are correct.

questions.question:
With reference to the impact of Western ideas on India, which of the following statements is correct?
A. English education opened the boundless doors of Western ideas, which initially overwhelmed them.
B. Acceptance of Western ideas that came through English education was synonymous with acceptance of British rule.
C. It immediately gave birth to political consciousness and resistance against political authority.
D. It awakened the spirit of rationalism, leading to a mental revolt against the tyranny of dogma and traditional authorities, beliefs and customs.
questions.explanation: English education first overwhelmed Indians with Western ideas (A) and awakened rationalism against dogma (D). Accepting Western ideas did not mean accepting British rule (B), and political resistance came later, not immediately (C).

questions.question: Which is the largest manganese producing state in India?
questions.explanation: As per the source key, Madhya Pradesh is the largest producer of manganese ore in India, followed by Maharashtra and Odisha.

questions.question: In which state is the Ankleshwar oil field located?
questions.explanation: Ankleshwar oil field is in Bharuch district of Gujarat. Digboi in Assam and Mumbai High off Maharashtra are other oil fields.

questions.question: The main industries of Dalmianagar in Bihar are:

options.A: Paper, cement, silk textiles and jute
options.B: Paper, chemicals, ceramics and vegetable oil
options.C: Paper, cement, sugar and vegetable oil

questions.explanation: Dalmianagar (Rohtas) was known for paper, cement, sugar and vegetable oil industries set up by the Dalmia group.

questions.question: The Bundelkhand plateau covers parts of which two of the following states?
questions.explanation: The Bundelkhand region and plateau lies across southern Uttar Pradesh and northern Madhya Pradesh.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of the peninsular river system?

options.D: Fixed courses with broad, shallow valleys

questions.explanation: Antecedent drainage is a feature of Himalayan rivers. Peninsular rivers are seasonal (monsoon-fed), have smaller basins and fixed courses in old, graded valleys.

questions.question: Most of the Sal forests are spread over which part of India?
questions.explanation: Sal (tropical moist deciduous) forests are found mostly in the eastern peninsular region: Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh and eastern Madhya Pradesh.

questions.question: Which nodal ministry at the Centre coordinates disaster management activities in India?

options.B: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
options.D: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

questions.explanation: The Ministry of Home Affairs is the nodal ministry for disaster management (except drought, which was earlier with Agriculture). NDMA is chaired by the Prime Minister.

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding multipurpose river projects is NOT correct?

options.A: They are developed to control floods and divert surplus water to water-deficient areas.
options.B: Reservoirs are constructed for water storage and the development of aquaculture.
options.C: They are an integrated plan for the development of canal irrigation and hydroelectric power generation.
options.D: They also help in inland navigation and fish breeding.

questions.explanation: As per the source key, statement 3 is not correct as framed; reservoirs of multipurpose projects are built mainly for water storage, irrigation and power, aquaculture is not the purpose of building them.

questions.question: What is 'Heat balance'?

options.A: The balance between the incident heat absorbed by the Earth and the heat going out as radiation
options.C: The balance between the heat emitted by the Sun and the incident heat absorbed by the Earth
options.D: The balance between land and sea temperatures

questions.explanation: Heat balance (heat budget) means the Earth radiates back as much heat as it absorbs from insolation, so its average temperature stays constant.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about the principal axis of a spherical mirror is correct?
(i) It is normal to the mirror.
(ii) The point of incidence always lies on the principal axis.
(iii) The principal focus always lies on the principal axis.
questions.explanation: The principal axis passes through the pole and centre of curvature, is normal to the mirror at the pole, and contains the principal focus. The point of incidence can be anywhere on the mirror.

questions.question: A solar eclipse occurs when:

options.A: The Moon is not on the line joining the Sun and the Earth
options.B: The Sun comes between the Moon and the Earth
options.C: The Moon comes between the Sun and the Earth
options.D: The Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon

questions.explanation: In a solar eclipse the Moon comes between the Sun and the Earth and casts its shadow on the Earth. When the Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon, it is a lunar eclipse.

questions.question: By what name is sodium carbonate commonly known?
questions.explanation: Sodium carbonate decahydrate (Na2CO3.10H2O) is washing soda. Baking soda is NaHCO3, caustic soda is NaOH and bleaching powder is CaOCl2.

questions.question: An atom of uranium-238 (atomic number 92, mass number 238) contains:
questions.explanation: Protons = atomic number = 92; electrons in a neutral atom = 92; neutrons = 238 - 92 = 146.

questions.question: The heart is devoid of (does not contain):
questions.explanation: The heart is made of cardiac muscle, which is involuntary and has intercalated discs. It has no voluntary (skeletal) muscle.

questions.question: The condition in which the concentration of glucose in the blood is very low is called:
questions.explanation: Hypo means low and glycemia refers to blood sugar, so low blood glucose is hypoglycemia. Hyperglycemia is high blood glucose.

questions.question: The centre of reflex action is:
questions.explanation: Reflex actions are controlled by the spinal cord through a reflex arc, without involving the brain's conscious centres.

questions.sourceRef: Full_Length_Test_1.pdf, Q55 (expression was an image in the PDF; rebuilt to match the key answer 60)
questions.question: Simplify the expression: 25 + 5 x 9 - 30 / 3

questions.concept: Smallest perfect square divisible by numbers
questions.question: Find the smallest perfect square number which is exactly divisible by 4, 5, 9 and 12.
questions.explanation: LCM(4, 5, 9, 12) = 180 = 2^2 x 3^2 x 5. To make it a perfect square multiply by 5: 180 x 5 = 900 = 30^2.

questions.question: An amount is to be divided among A, B and C in the ratio 5 : 2 : 8. If the difference between the shares of A and C is Rs. 7,740, what is the total amount?

Mahesh and Harish invest Rs. 20,000 and Rs. 30,000 respectively in a business. If after 3 months Harish withdraws Rs. 5,000 from his investment, in what ratio will the profit be divided between them (at the end of the year)?
Five years ago, the ratio of the ages of a father and his son was 7 : 2. Five years hence, the ratio of their ages will be 9 : 4. After how many years will the father's age be twice his son's age?
questions.explanation: Let ages 5 years ago be 7x and 2x. (7x + 10)/(2x + 10) = 9/4 gives x = 5. Present ages: 40 and 15. 40 + t = 2(15 + t) gives t = 10.

questions.question: In an examination, A's marks are 20% more than B's marks, and C's marks are equal to 85% of the total marks of A and B. By what percentage are A's marks less than C's marks?
A trader sells a shirt at 6% less than its marked price. He marks the shirt 15% above its cost price. What is the profit percentage earned by the trader?
questions.explanation: Let CP = 100, then MP = 115 and SP = 115 x 0.94 = 108.1. Profit = 8.1%.

questions.question: Pipe A can fill an empty tank in 5 hours and pipe B takes 6.25 hours to fill it. When the tank was empty, both pipes were opened together, but after some time pipe B was closed, and the tank took 3.4 hours to fill. For how many hours was pipe B open?
questions.explanation: A works for all 3.4 hours: 3.4/5 = 0.68 of the tank. The remaining 0.32 is filled by B at 1/6.25 = 0.16 per hour, so B was open 0.32/0.16 = 2 hours.

questions.question: Which national park has recently been declared India's 58th tiger reserve?
questions.explanation: Madhav National Park in Shivpuri, Madhya Pradesh, was notified as India's 58th tiger reserve in March 2025 (the 9th in Madhya Pradesh).

questions.question: With which country has India recently signed a Cultural Property Agreement to prevent the smuggling of Indian antiquities?
questions.explanation: India and the USA signed the Cultural Property Agreement in July 2024 to prevent illicit trafficking of antiquities from India to the US.

questions.question: According to recent information, in which districts will the Bihar government set up Special Economic Zones (SEZ) in 2025?
questions.explanation: The Bihar government announced SEZs in Buxar and West Champaran districts in 2025.

questions.question: Which company has recently launched the AI-powered 'FireSat' satellite?
questions.explanation: Google (with Earth Fire Alliance and Muon Space) launched the first FireSat satellite in 2025 to detect wildfires using AI.

questions.question: At which airport did Union Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu recently inaugurate the 'Udan Yatri Cafe'?
questions.explanation: As per the source, the 'Udan Yatri Cafe' offering affordable food to passengers was inaugurated at Chennai International Airport (after the first one at Kolkata).

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:
1. India recently participated in the 6th edition of the joint military exercise 'Dharma Guardian' 2025 with Japan.
2. The exercise was held from 24 February to 9 March 2025 at the East Fuji Manoeuvre Training Area in Japan.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Both statements are correct: the 6th edition of the India-Japan exercise Dharma Guardian was held at East Fuji, Japan, from 24 February to 9 March 2025.

questions.question: What is the main objective of the TEAM initiative recently launched by the Ministry of MSME?

options.A: To provide financial assistance to small industries
options.B: To promote entrepreneurship in rural areas
options.C: To strengthen the digital presence of small businesses
options.D: To provide skill training to traditional artisans

questions.explanation: TEAM (Trade Enablement and Marketing) helps micro and small enterprises go online through ONDC, strengthening their digital presence.

questions.question: Where was India's first open-air art wall museum recently inaugurated?
questions.explanation: India's first open-air art wall museum was inaugurated in New Delhi.

questions.question: The decimal number (95)10 is equal to:
Which logic gate gives a high output only when its inputs are different?
questions.explanation: A two-input XOR gate outputs 1 only when the inputs differ. XNOR outputs 1 when they are the same.

questions.question: What is the memory element in a combinational logic circuit?
questions.explanation: The output of a combinational circuit depends only on its present inputs, so it has no memory element. Flip-flops, latches and registers belong to sequential circuits.

questions.question: How many inputs and outputs does an 8-to-3 encoder have?
questions.explanation: An encoder converts 2^n inputs into n outputs, so an 8-to-3 encoder has 8 inputs and 3 outputs. 3 inputs and 8 outputs describes a decoder.

questions.question: How many inputs and outputs does a Half Adder have?
questions.explanation: A half adder adds two bits (A, B) and produces two outputs: Sum and Carry. A full adder has 3 inputs and 2 outputs.

questions.question: Which register is used to transfer data in a parallel manner at one time?
questions.explanation: A PIPO register loads all bits at once and outputs all bits at once, so data is transferred in parallel.

questions.question: What is the full form of CISC?
questions.explanation: CISC stands for Complex Instruction Set Computer, as opposed to RISC (Reduced Instruction Set Computer).

questions.question: What is the main advantage of multi-core processors in computer architecture?
questions.explanation: Multiple cores can execute multiple threads or tasks simultaneously, giving better parallel processing.

questions.question: What type of memory is RAM?
questions.explanation: RAM loses its contents when power is switched off, so it is volatile primary memory.

questions.question: What is the main function of ROM?

options.D: Store the bootstrap program and firmware

questions.explanation: ROM is non-volatile and stores firmware such as the BIOS and the bootstrap loader needed to start the computer.

questions.question: Which of the following is a 'non-linear' data structure?
questions.explanation: Trees and graphs are non-linear because elements are not arranged in a single sequence. Arrays, linked lists and queues are linear.

questions.question: On what principle does a Stack operate?
questions.explanation: In a stack, insertion (push) and deletion (pop) happen at the top, so the last element inserted is removed first: LIFO.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a comparison-based sorting algorithm?
questions.explanation: Counting Sort counts occurrences of key values instead of comparing elements. Quick, Selection and Merge Sort are comparison-based.

questions.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of searching for an element in an (unsorted) array?
questions.explanation: In the worst case every element must be checked, giving O(n). O(log n) needs a sorted array and binary search.

questions.question: What is the data requirement for a Linear Search algorithm?

options.B: Data must be in a tree
options.D: Data must be stored in a stack

questions.explanation: Linear search checks elements one by one, so it works on unsorted data. Sorting is required for binary search.

questions.question: Which graph traversal algorithm explores as far as possible along each branch before backtracking?
questions.explanation: DFS goes deep along one branch (using a stack or recursion) before backtracking. BFS explores level by level.

questions.question: Which technique is used to resolve collisions in a hash table?

options.D: Linear probing, chaining and quadratic probing can all be used

questions.explanation: Collisions can be resolved by separate chaining or by open addressing, which includes linear probing and quadratic probing. All three are valid techniques.

questions.concept: Internal nodes in full binary tree
questions.question: In a full binary tree, if there are 'n' nodes, what is the number of internal nodes?
questions.explanation: In a full binary tree, leaves L = I + 1 and n = I + L = 2I + 1, so I = (n - 1)/2. The number of leaves is (n + 1)/2.

questions.question: In data structures, 'enqueue' and 'dequeue' operations are related to:
questions.explanation: Enqueue inserts at the rear and dequeue removes from the front of a queue. Stacks use push and pop.

questions.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of Merge Sort?
questions.explanation: Merge sort always divides the array into halves (log n levels) and merges in O(n) per level, giving O(n log n) in all cases.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a Greedy Algorithm?
questions.explanation: Kruskal's algorithm greedily picks the smallest edge that does not form a cycle. Merge Sort and Binary Search are divide and conquer.

questions.question: On what type of graph does the Bellman-Ford algorithm work for the single-source shortest path problem?
questions.explanation: Bellman-Ford works even when edge weights are negative (and can detect negative cycles), unlike Dijkstra's algorithm.

questions.question: Backtracking algorithms are typically used to solve problems that involve:

options.A: Finding the optimal solution only by greedy choice

questions.explanation: Backtracking builds candidates step by step and abandons those that fail, which is used to explore all possible solutions (e.g. N-Queens, subset sum).

questions.question: Prim's Algorithm is used to solve which problem?
questions.explanation: Prim's algorithm finds a minimum spanning tree of a connected weighted graph by growing it one vertex at a time.

questions.question: Which algorithm can be used to check connectivity in a graph?
questions.explanation: Running BFS from any vertex and checking whether all vertices are visited tells whether the graph is connected.

questions.question: Which part of the operating system manages files and directories?
questions.explanation: The file system (file management component) organises, stores, names and retrieves files and directories.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a goal of an operating system?
questions.explanation: An OS manages resources, processes and provides a user interface. Designing hardware is not its function.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a Real-Time Operating System?
questions.explanation: VxWorks is a real-time OS used in embedded systems. Windows, Linux and macOS are general-purpose operating systems.

questions.question: Which mechanism is used for inter-process communication?
questions.explanation: The two basic IPC models are shared memory and message passing (with semaphores used for synchronisation). Paging and compaction are memory management techniques and thrashing is a performance problem.

questions.question: Which strategy is used to prevent deadlock?
questions.explanation: Deadlock is prevented by denying one of the four necessary conditions; ordering resources to break circular wait is a standard method. Hold and wait is a condition that causes deadlock.

questions.question: When does a Page Fault occur?

options.A: When a page is found in main memory
options.B: When a page is written to disk
options.C: When a page is not found in main memory
options.D: When a page is replaced using LRU

questions.explanation: A page fault occurs when a referenced page is not present in main memory and must be brought in from secondary storage.

questions.question: In paging, a virtual address is divided into:
questions.explanation: The logical address in paging = page number (index into page table) + page offset. Segment number and offset is used in segmentation.

questions.question: Which of the following is a disk scheduling algorithm?
questions.explanation: SSTF serves the request closest to the current head position. LRU and OPT are page replacement algorithms and Round Robin is a CPU scheduling algorithm.

questions.question: Which method is used to reduce the burden on the CPU for completing Input/Output (I/O) operations?
questions.explanation: DMA lets a controller transfer data directly between memory and the device, so the CPU is free during the transfer.

questions.question: In a file system, what is the main advantage of 'indexed allocation'?
questions.explanation: Indexed allocation keeps all block pointers in an index block, so any block can be accessed directly. It does need extra space for the index block.

questions.question: What is 'Concurrency'?

options.A: Execution of only one process at a time.
options.B: Multiple processes executing (or appearing to execute) at the same time.
options.D: Running a process only on the GPU.

questions.explanation: Concurrency means multiple processes make progress in overlapping time periods, either truly in parallel or by interleaving on one CPU.

questions.question: Which parameters are used together to identify the location of data on a disk?

options.D: Cylinder, head (track) and sector together (CHS address)

questions.explanation: Data on a disk is located by its CHS address: cylinder, head (track) and sector numbers are all needed together.

questions.question: What is the largest logical unit of data in a DBMS?
questions.explanation: Data hierarchy: bit, byte, field, record, file (table), database. The database is the largest unit.

questions.question: Which of the following is a type of 'Data Integrity' in DBMS?

options.D: Entity, referential and domain integrity are all types

questions.explanation: Entity integrity (primary key not null and unique), referential integrity (valid foreign keys) and domain integrity (valid values for attributes) are all types of data integrity.

questions.question: What is the 'Join' operation used for in a database?

options.A: To delete data from two tables.
options.B: To combine related data from two or more tables.
options.C: To insert new data into a table.
options.D: To create a backup of a table.

questions.explanation: A JOIN combines rows from two or more tables based on a related column.

questions.question: Which command is used to add a new column to an existing table in SQL?
questions.explanation: Structure changes use ALTER TABLE, e.g. ALTER TABLE student ADD COLUMN age INT. INSERT adds rows and UPDATE modifies values.

questions.question: What is the main characteristic of a Primary Key for a relation in a database?

options.C: A table can have many primary keys.
options.D: It uniquely identifies each record in the table.

questions.explanation: A primary key uniquely identifies each tuple; it cannot be NULL or duplicate, and a table has only one primary key.

questions.question: What does 'Data Redundancy' mean in a DBMS?

options.B: Removing unnecessary data from the database.
options.C: Storing the same data in multiple places.

questions.explanation: Redundancy is duplication of the same data in many places, which wastes space and can cause inconsistency. Accuracy and consistency describes integrity.

questions.question: 'ACID properties' in DBMS are related to:
questions.explanation: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation and Durability are the properties that a reliable transaction must satisfy.

questions.question: What is a 'Schema' in the context of a database?

options.A: The logical structure or design of the database.
options.B: The actual data stored in the database.
options.C: The number of users of the database.
options.D: A query used to fetch data.

questions.explanation: A schema is the overall logical design (tables, attributes, relationships). The actual data at a moment is an instance.

questions.question: The Network Access Layer of the TCP/IP model is equivalent to which layers of the OSI model?
questions.explanation: The TCP/IP Network Access (Link) layer combines the OSI Physical and Data Link layers. The OSI Network layer maps to the TCP/IP Internet layer.

questions.question: Which network device is used to connect different network segments and route data packets?
questions.explanation: A router works at the network layer and forwards packets between different networks using IP addresses.

questions.question: What is a network of computers located within the same small geographical area (like a building) called?
questions.explanation: A Local Area Network connects computers within a limited area such as a room, building or campus.

questions.question: What does 'Bandwidth' mean in data transmission?

options.A: The maximum amount of data that can be transmitted over a network in a given period.
options.B: The time taken for data transmission.
options.C: The physical length of the network cable.
options.D: The number of devices on the network.

questions.explanation: Bandwidth is the maximum data transfer capacity of a channel, measured in bits per second. Time taken is latency.

questions.question: Which network security device protects a network from unauthorised access and malicious activities?
questions.explanation: A firewall filters incoming and outgoing traffic according to security rules to block unauthorised access.

questions.question: In the OSI model, which layer is responsible for ensuring end-to-end connectivity and data integrity?
questions.explanation: The transport layer (e.g. TCP) provides end-to-end delivery, error control, flow control and segmentation.

questions.question: Which is the most secure way to transmit data from one device to another?
questions.explanation: Guided (wired) media keep the signal inside a physical cable, making interception harder than with signals broadcast through the air.

questions.question: What is the main drawback of the 'Waterfall Model' in software engineering?

options.A: Phases are completed sequentially and it is difficult to go back to earlier phases.

questions.explanation: The waterfall model is linear and rigid; once a phase is complete, going back to change requirements or design is difficult and costly.

questions.question: Which activity is involved in 'Software Maintenance'?

options.C: Only testing the quality of software.
options.D: Improving existing software and fixing errors.

questions.explanation: Maintenance means modifying delivered software to correct faults, improve performance or adapt to changes.

questions.question: What is the main objective of 'Agile Methodology'?

options.A: To prevent changes in customer requirements.
options.C: To enable rapid and adaptive development.
options.D: To finish all phases strictly one after another.

questions.explanation: Agile delivers software in short iterations and welcomes changing requirements, enabling rapid and adaptive development.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of software testing?
questions.explanation: Unit, integration and system testing are software testing levels. Manufacturing testing relates to hardware production.

questions.question: What does 'Inheritance' mean in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)?

options.A: One class/object acquiring the properties and methods of another.
options.B: Using different types of data under the same name.
options.D: Binding a function call at run time.

questions.explanation: Inheritance lets a derived class reuse properties and methods of a base class. Using one name for many forms is polymorphism and hiding data is encapsulation.

questions.question: In C++, members of a class that can be accessed only by members of the same class and its friend functions are defined under which access specifier?
questions.explanation: Private members are accessible only within the class and by its friends. Protected members are also accessible in derived classes.

questions.question: Which scripting language runs on the client side to make web pages interactive?
questions.explanation: JavaScript runs in the browser (client side). PHP, Python and Perl are typically used on the server side.

questions.question: What does the 'S' stand for in 'HTTPS'?
questions.explanation: HTTPS is HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure; it encrypts traffic using SSL/TLS.

questions.question: Which symbol marks the beginning of a variable name in PHP?
questions.explanation: All PHP variables start with the $ sign, e.g. $name.

questions.question: In PHP, which loop is specially used to iterate over all the values of an array?
questions.explanation: foreach is designed for arrays: foreach ($arr as $value) visits every element without an index counter.

questions.question: Which of the following is a client-side scripting language?
questions.explanation: VBScript (like JavaScript) can run in the browser as a client-side scripting language. Python and Ruby are mainly server-side, and HTML is a markup language, not a scripting language.

questions.question: 'Finite Automata' are primarily used for which type of languages?
questions.explanation: Finite automata recognise exactly the regular languages. Context-free languages need pushdown automata and recursively enumerable languages need Turing machines.

questions.question: What does the regular expression a*b mean?

options.A: Any number of 'a's (zero or more), followed by exactly one 'b'.
options.B: Strings containing only 'a' and 'b' in any order.
options.C: Any number of 'a's and any number of 'b's.
options.D: Exactly one 'a' followed by any number of 'b's.

questions.explanation: a* means zero or more a's and is followed by a single b, e.g. b, ab, aab.

questions.question: When is a grammar called a 'Context-Free Grammar' (CFG)?

options.A: If its production rules are of the form xAy -> xzy, depending on the surrounding symbols.
options.B: If its production rules are of the form aA -> B.
options.C: If its production rules generate only terminals.
options.D: If its production rules are of the form A -> B, where A is a single non-terminal and B is any string of terminals and non-terminals.

questions.explanation: In a CFG, the left side of every production is a single non-terminal, so it can be replaced regardless of context. A rule like xAy -> xzy is context-sensitive.

questions.question: What is the main function of 'Lexical Analysis' in compiler design?

options.C: Breaking the input program into tokens.

questions.explanation: The lexical analyser (scanner) reads the source characters and groups them into tokens. Syntax errors are found in parsing.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a major component of IoT (Internet of Things)?
questions.explanation: IoT systems consist of sensors/actuators, connectivity, data processing and a user interface. A traditional printer is not an IoT component.

questions.question: What is an example of a 'Smart Home' application in IoT?
questions.explanation: Smart home IoT uses connected devices to automate lights, temperature, security and appliances.

questions.question: What types of sensors are commonly used to collect data in IoT devices?

options.D: Various sensors like temperature, humidity, light, etc.

questions.explanation: IoT devices use many kinds of sensors depending on the application, such as temperature, humidity, light, motion and pressure.

questions.question: What is the importance of 'Edge Computing' in IoT?

options.A: Sending all data immediately to a central cloud server.
options.B: Increasing power consumption of IoT devices.
options.C: Processing data closer to the source, reducing latency.
options.D: Storing data only on local hard disks permanently.

questions.explanation: Edge computing processes data near where it is generated, reducing latency and bandwidth needed to reach the cloud.

questions.question: What does 'Machine Learning' mean in AI?

options.A: Only teaching a computer to follow instructions.
options.B: The ability of computers to learn from data and make predictions without being explicitly programmed.
options.C: Teaching a computer to talk like a human.

questions.explanation: Machine learning lets systems learn patterns from data and improve without explicit rules for every case. Talking like humans is NLP.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a subfield of AI?
questions.explanation: Robotics, NLP and computer vision are AI subfields. Traditional web design is not.

questions.question: 'Deep Learning' is based on what type of neural network?
questions.explanation: Deep learning uses neural networks with many hidden layers. A single-layer perceptron is not 'deep'.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of E-commerce?

options.D: Higher need for physical presence of customers

questions.explanation: E-commerce lets businesses sell round the clock to customers anywhere in the world.

questions.question: What is an example of a 'B2C' e-commerce model?

options.A: A company selling products to another company.
options.B: A business selling products directly to consumers.
options.C: An individual selling products to another individual.
options.D: A consumer selling services to a business.

questions.explanation: B2C (Business to Consumer) means a business sells directly to end consumers, e.g. an online retail store. The others describe B2B, C2C and C2B.

questions.question: Which protocol is used to ensure security in e-commerce transactions?
questions.explanation: SSL/TLS encrypts data between the browser and server, protecting payment details. FTP, SMTP and plain HTTP are not secure by themselves.

questions.question: What does 'Audio' mean in multimedia?
questions.explanation: Audio is the sound element of multimedia: speech, music and sound effects.

questions.sourceRef: Full_Length_Test_1.pdf, Q149 (answer key missing in PDF)
questions.question: What is the benefit of combining images with text in a multimedia presentation?

options.C: Making information more engaging and easier to understand.

questions.explanation: Images with text improve attention and understanding. (The PDF does not print an answer key for this question; option 2 is the evident answer.)

questions.sourceRef: Full_Length_Test_1.pdf, Q150 missing in PDF; added to complete 150
questions.question: Which of the following image file formats uses lossy compression and is commonly used for photographs in multimedia?
questions.explanation: JPEG uses lossy compression, giving small file sizes for photos. PNG and GIF use lossless compression and BMP is usually uncompressed.
